# Onuros

Onuros is a privacy-focused proof-of-work blockchain project in development-network testing. It is not live on mainnet and has not completed an independent production security audit.

## Core principles

- Private payments are designed to conceal sender, receiver, and amount on-chain.
- Disclosure is controlled by the user; there is no master viewing key.
- Mining is GPU-oriented proof of work with CPU verification.
- The economic model specifies a 60-second block target, 20 ONUROS initial block reward, four-year halving interval, 0.5 ONUROS permanent reward floor, and no premine or presale.
